strokes._: polyline; third value = joint radius px (default 0 = sharp); join = miter (sharp, the default) | round | bevel (flat), per stroke or glyph-level 'join'

4th value = bulge (DXF style, tan(angle/4)): the segment to the NEXT point becomes a circular arc; + bends counter-clockwise on the page, - clockwise. Lines and arcs mix in one path (this is a D bowl with two quarter circles)
arc: degrees CCW as on the page, 0 = right, 90 = up
full ring; width overrides the glyph width
cut mask polygon: subtracted from the finished outline

dots._: dots: [x,y,r], [x,y,r,shape], [x,y,r,shape,corner] or an object; r = half size; shape circle|square|rounded; glyph-level dot_shape/dot_corner set the defaults

_comment: Copy to <name>.json, set char to the real character (or a list of characters), delete the '_' notes. rows = band of the pixel mask to discard (accents outside it are still traced automatically). clip_y / clip_x = [min, max]: everything outside the band is cut away (trims round joins flush with cap/baseline).
